Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Vânzări cu amănuntul și Transport, logistică, lanț de aprovizionare și depozitare
ABOUT US 
 SAG Digital is a subsidiary of Swiss Automotive Group AG (SAG), a leading company in the independent automotive aftermarket across Europe. With a strong presence in 12 countries, SAG generates annual sales exceeding 1.1 billion euros. At our offices in Cologne (GER), Cham (CH), Cluj, and Satu Mare (RO), we design, develop, and operate innovative e-commerce solutions, webshops, and apps for SAG companies. Our expertise spans cloud/DevOps, Agile software development, ERP, logistics, and IT security, enabling us to drive digital transformation in the automotive aftermarket.
 At SAG Digital, we're not just another company – we're a family of forward-thinkers, innovators, and passionate individuals who are dedicated to transforming the automotive aftermarket industry. Here, we're not just building careers; we're forging futures. Explore our world and discover why SAG Digital is the place for you.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 As a Senior Full-Stack Developer, you join our Webshop Team and take end-to-end ownership of features and improvements across our e-commerce platforms – from database and backend services to the user-facing experience. You ensure stability, performance, and a smooth shopping experience for millions of users, while continuously evolving a mature product landscape.
 You go beyond implementation: you analyze and understand complex problems, challenge assumptions, and actively drive technical decisions in close collaboration with developers, architects, product, and business stakeholders.
Own and evolve features across the full stack of our e-commerce webshops – backend, database, and frontend
Build and improve customer-facing storefront experiences as well as internal tools supporting the webshop
Optimize SQL queries and ensure high performance in data-intensive workloads
Evolve database structures in a living, business-critical environment
Collaborate on software architecture, maintainability, and system evolution to reduce technical complexity instead of adding to it
Use Git (GitLab and/or GitHub) and contribute to modern CI/CD pipelines
Work closely with product, developers and business stakeholders to identify real problems and create effective solutions
 WHAT YOU BRING 
5+ years of experience as a full-stack developer with C# / .NET, including solid hands-on experience with ASP.NET MVC
Strong .NET Framework know-how
Solid SQL know-how and experience with relational databases (e.g. MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL)
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services
Proactive, structured mindset with strong technical ownership
A mindset that balances pragmatism and quality in evolving, non-greenfield environments
Experience in e-commerce or marketplace environments is a plus
React know-how is a plus
Clear communication and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical peers
Fluent in English (working language in tech and cross-team collaboration)
 WHAT WE OFFER 
A key role in our Webshop Team, working on platforms with real business impact for millions of users
Significant influence on architecture and technical direction
High level of autonomy and pragmatic, outcome-driven decision-making
Short decision-making paths and direct communication
A team that values collaboration, clarity, and continuous improvement
Flexible working hours and remote options
Agile work environment with clear Scrum processes
Continuous development with a guaranteed annual learning budget
Access to cutting-edge technologies and tools
A Regina Maria health subscription
A 13th salary at the end of the year
Regular team events like summer parties and monthly lunches
A diverse and international team culture
 Welcome to SAG Digital: Your Future Awaits! 
 Join us and be part of a dynamic team driving digital innovation in the automotive aftermarket. Shape the future of e-commerce with us – we look forward to meeting you!
